summary:
Iter 10 — verified the new-feature batch (barcode scanning on Quick sale, Bulk photos, Quick sale photo-first 2-col grid, Excel/CSV import with photo_url). Backend: 12/12 tests pass. Frontend: every review-request flow works end to end, no red screen, no expo-camera / xlsx / expo-image-picker runtime errors.

BACKEND (owner@tredi.app) — /app/backend/tests/test_photo_and_import.py, 12/12 pass:
- PATCH /api/items/{id}/photo sets ONLY photo_url (leaves name/cost/selling/quantity untouched), persists across GET /api/items and GET /api/items/{id}, returns 404 for a valid-shape but unknown ObjectId, and accepts empty string to clear. Original photo restored in teardown.
- GET /api/import/template?target=items now returns columns [name, category, unit, cost_price, selling_price, quantity, barcode, photo_url] — 'photo_url' present in both the columns list AND the CSV header row. customers template unchanged.
- POST /api/import/preview accepts photo_url in row values (ready_count=1). POST /api/import/commit persists photo_url on the created item — verified by GET /api/items; imported test item deleted in teardown.
- Regression on validate_rows: item missing name → blocked, item non-numeric cost → bad_number, item name collision with existing seed item → duplicate, customer missing name → blocked, customer missing phone → blocked, customer non-numeric opening_balance → bad_number. All kinds surface exactly as before.

FRONTEND (390x844 web preview, owner@tredi.app):
- /quick-sale: 2-per-row grid confirmed by bounding-box measurement — tile[0] and tile[1] share y=148, width ≈175px (viewport 390/2 - gap). 28 tiles rendered; the two seed items with photos ('Adeba Rice 50kg' and one other) show real Photo images (data-testid quick-sale-photo-*). Tapping a tile adds to cart (cart card appears, quick-sale-total updates to ₦62,000 for Adeba Rice at 1x). Cash → Take payment opens tender-sheet, Exact preset → tender-save → sale-saved-sheet appears within 2.5s. Full sale flow works.
- /quick-sale scanner: BOTH quick-sale-scan (app bar) AND quick-sale-search-scan (in the search box) open scanner-modal. On web the modal shows scanner-permission with 'Allow camera' (scanner-allow) and 'Search by name instead' (scanner-skip). Tapping scanner-skip or scanner-close returns cleanly to /quick-sale with quick-sale-screen visible and no crash.
- /stock/photos: progress card 'stock-photos-progress' correctly reads '2 of 28 items have a photo'. Filter Seg shows All (28) / Missing (26). Tapping any tile opens stock-photo-source-sheet with 'Take a photo' (stock-photo-camera) and 'Choose from gallery' (stock-photo-gallery). On web tapping gallery does not crash — stock-photos-screen still mounted. Note: in Missing filter view no tile carries a photo (correct — Missing is items WITHOUT photo). Tiles that do have photos render <Image> via stock-photo-img-*.
- Stock tab: stock-photos-nudge card shows '26 items have no photo' with 'Add photos' button (stock-photos-cta). The app-bar images-outline button (stock-photos) navigates to /stock/photos. Nudge CTA also navigates to /stock/photos.
- /stock/new?barcode=1234567890: Screenshot (/tmp/iter10_stocknew_step0.png) confirms Barcode field on step 0 is pre-filled with '1234567890'. item-barcode-scan icon opens scanner-modal correctly. Without the query, barcode defaults to empty.
- /settings/import: header copy reads 'Choose an Excel or CSV file' (contains 'Excel or CSV'). Paste CSV → import-check-paste → import-report shows '1 rows are ready · Nothing to fix'. import-commit succeeds and resets to the picker screen — no error.
- Console during full run: 0 xlsx / expo-camera / expo-image-picker errors. 3 low-severity console entries — 2×404 on unrelated resource fetches (likely favicons/asset probes) and 1 React Native Web deprecation warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' (see react_native_issues).

Deprecated packages detected: none. SafeAreaView issues detected: none.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web logs 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Not from this feature batch specifically — a repeated console warning on the web preview. Search the codebase for `pointerEvents=` props on <View>/<Pressable> and move them into style. Non-blocking.

action_items: Optional cleanup: migrate `pointerEvents={...}` props to `style={{ pointerEvents: ... }}` to silence the React Native Web deprecation warning. Not blocking any flow.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py:308-315 — set_item_photo uses biz_filter to scope the update to the caller's business, returns clean() (excludes _id), and returns 404 when matched_count==0. Good. No leak of other fields.

/app/backend/routes/offline.py:115 & 162 & 201 & 211 — photo_url is added to ITEM_COLS, threaded through validate_rows, stored on insert_many, and included in the template CSV. Note r.get('photo_url') or None correctly maps blank string to None so the DB does not carry empty-string photo paths.

/app/frontend/app/quick-sale.tsx:75-84 — onScan matches (barcode ?? '').trim() against the scanned code; unknown code opens the 'Create this item' sheet with the scanned code visible and a button that routes to /stock/new?barcode=<code>. Correct end-to-end.

/app/frontend/app/stock/new.tsx:36 & 51 — useLocalSearchParams<{ barcode?: string }>() + useState(params.barcode ?? '') is idiomatic and confirmed to prefill via URL. barcode-scan icon opens the same Scanner component and setBarcode is wired on onScan.

/app/frontend/src/components/scanner.tsx:56-72 — Modal wraps CameraView with a permission gate; the permission explainer (scanner-permission + scanner-allow + scanner-skip) is what web preview correctly shows, and onClose is symmetric so pressing scanner-close/skip cleanly closes. No crash path when camera is unavailable.

/app/frontend/app/stock/photos.tsx:82-116 — Empty filter path, per-tile Photo component, and source Sheet all wired with distinct testIDs. save() is called with true/false to distinguish camera vs gallery, matching the design.

/app/frontend/app/settings/import.tsx:135-172 — Paste path uses the same validate/commit endpoints as the file-picker path, so backend tests cover both. Copy line 'Choose an Excel or CSV file' is present.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all 5 requested flows verified end to end, 0 xlsx/expo-camera/expo-image-picker runtime errors

PATCH-photo tests swapped photo_url on the first owner-scoped item and restored the original in teardown. Frontend paste test created one customer 'TEST_iter10_paste_ok' (not cleaned up — main agent may want to delete it via /customers if desired; single row).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Everything in the review request is verified passing. Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_photo_and_import.py (12 tests, 2.6s runtime). Public URL: https://ui-flow-accurate.preview.emergentagent.com. Login owner@tredi.app / tredi1234 via /sign-in (skip onboarding).
